sources_considered.why: Versioned manuscript identifies the framework and its original reported scores. Used only as context because Marcus is a coauthor.
Read to establish version history. Its current abstract reflects a later revision, so the versioned original was preferred.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, paragraph preceding the ten cognitive components
evidence_items.explanation: The original arXiv version reports a ten-domain framework and estimated scores of 27% for GPT-4 and 58% for GPT-5. This establishes what the framework asserts, but Marcus's coauthorship prevents treating it as independent confirmation; the arXiv deposit also postdates his post.

This independent study reports a large human–model gap in recognizing valid times on unusual analog clocks. It supplies evidence of a specific visual limitation, but neither measures the entire cognitive framework nor establishes October performance.

unresolved_gaps: The search did not locate an independent assessment reproducing the full framework for the systems current at publication.
Independent evidence of a narrow visual deficit does not determine the fraction of the framework achieved.
The retrieved original arXiv manuscript was deposited after the post; the exact publication-day manuscript was not independently authenticated.
The paper's reported 58% score would not support interpreting fraction as necessarily a small minority.
